notes: The told one-liner becomes a two-line session: the reported speech turns into the patient's line and the therapist's demand. Patient slumped on the couch, therapist in glasses at the desk.
title: Vorkasse

lines.text: Ich habe Selbstmordgedanken.
Dann zahlen Sie ab jetzt im Voraus.

notes: Kept the man's line word for word, split in two. The woman stays silent and terrified in bed so the stranger reveal lands on the last line; the man walks in wearing an apron.
title: Breakfast in Bed

lines.text: If I make you breakfast in bed, a simple "thank you" is all I need.
Not all this "how did you get in my house?!" business.

notes: Translated line by line; he says 'ты', her quoted scream uses 'вы', which underlines that she doesn't know him. The woman stays silent in bed.
title: Завтрак в постель

lines.text: Если я делаю тебе завтрак в постель, мне достаточно простого «спасибо».
А не вот этого всего: «как вы попали ко мне в дом?!»

notes: Translated line by line; 'business' becomes 'Theater'. He uses 'du', her quoted scream 'Sie'. The woman stays silent in bed.
title: Frühstück im Bett

lines.text: Wenn ich dir Frühstück ans Bett mache, reicht mir ein einfaches „Danke“.
Nicht dieses ganze Theater von wegen „Wie sind Sie in mein Haus gekommen?!“

notes: All four lines kept as written and spoken by the boyfriend, who stands at the fridge holding the note. The girlfriend has already left, so she is not on screen.
title: The Note

lines.text: My girlfriend left a note on the fridge.
"This is not working, I'm going to my mum's house."
So, I opened the fridge's door, the light came on and the juice was cold.
What the hell did she mean?

notes: Translated line by line; 'это не работает' carries both meanings in colloquial Russian, as the note says. Boyfriend at the fridge holding the note.
title: Записка

lines.text: Моя девушка оставила записку на холодильнике.
«Это не работает. Я уезжаю к маме».
Ну, я открыл дверцу холодильника, свет загорелся, и сок был холодный.
Что она, чёрт возьми, имела в виду?

notes: Translated line by line; 'Das funktioniert nicht' covers both the relationship and the appliance. Boyfriend at the fridge holding the note.
title: Der Zettel

lines.text: Meine Freundin hat einen Zettel am Kühlschrank hinterlassen.
„Das funktioniert nicht. Ich gehe zu meiner Mutter.“
Also hab ich die Kühlschranktür aufgemacht, das Licht ging an und der Saft war kalt.
Was zum Teufel meinte sie damit?

notes: Reported call turned into a cross-cut phone call: a stern teacher in glasses in the classroom, then the man at home. Fixed the typo 'son's has'; the reply is split so the reveal is its own line.
title: The Call from School

lines.text: The school phoned a man today.
Your son has been telling lies.
Tell him, he's bloody good.
I don't have any kids.

notes: Translated line by line; 'bloody good' becomes 'чертовски хорош'. Cross-cut phone call between the classroom and the man's living room.
title: Звонок из школы

lines.text: Сегодня мужику позвонили из школы.
Ваш сын врёт.
Передайте ему, что он чертовски хорош.
У меня нет детей.

notes: Translated line by line; 'bloody good' becomes 'verdammt gut'. Cross-cut phone call between the classroom and the man's living room.
title: Anruf von der Schule

lines.text: Heute hat die Schule bei einem Mann angerufen.
Ihr Sohn erzählt Lügen.
Sagen Sie ihm, er ist verdammt gut.
Ich habe gar keine Kinder.

notes: Father walks in with a suitcase and fondly recalls; the son in a hood on the sofa delivers the first words. 'fuck' softened to 'heck' in text, kept in uncensored.
title: First Words

lines.text: I will never forget my son's first words.
Where the heck have you been for sixteen years?
lines.uncensored: Where the fuck have you been for sixteen years?

notes: Translated line by line; 'fuck' rendered as 'блядь', softened to 'блин'. Father with a suitcase at the door, son in a hood on the sofa.
title: Первые слова

lines.text: Никогда не забуду первые слова моего сына.
Где тебя, блин, носило шестнадцать лет?
lines.uncensored: Где тебя, блядь, носило шестнадцать лет?

notes: Translated line by line; 'fuck' rendered as 'verfickt', softened to 'verdammt'. Father with a suitcase at the door, son in a hood on the sofa.
title: Die ersten Worte

lines.text: Ich werde die ersten Worte meines Sohnes nie vergessen.
Wo verdammt nochmal warst du sechzehn Jahre lang?
lines.uncensored: Wo verfickt nochmal warst du sechzehn Jahre lang?

notes: Lecture kept word for word, split into three lines; 'a voice from the back' is shown by the student at the back desk. A few students sit in the room as a silent crowd.
title: Double Positive

lines.text: An MIT linguistics professor was lecturing his class the other day.
In English, a double negative forms a positive.
However, in some languages, such as Russian, a double negative remains a negative.
But there isn't a single language, not one, in which a double positive can express a negative.
Yeah, right.

notes: Per adaptNote the example language is Spanish (also keeps a double negative negative), since Russian viewers hear the lecture in Russian; the punch is the sarcastic double 'да': 'Ну да, ну да.'
title: Двойное утверждение

lines.text: Как-то раз профессор лингвистики из Массачусетского технологического читал студентам лекцию.
В английском двойное отрицание даёт утверждение.
Однако в некоторых языках, например в испанском, двойное отрицание остаётся отрицанием.
Но нет ни одного языка, ни одного, в котором двойное утверждение выражало бы отрицание.
Ну да, ну да.

notes: Translated line by line; 'Yeah, right' becomes the sarcastic 'Ja, ja.' MIT spelled out so German TTS doesn't read it as 'mit'.
title: Doppelte Bejahung

lines.text: Ein Linguistikprofessor vom Massachusetts Institute of Technology hielt neulich eine Vorlesung.
Im Englischen ergibt eine doppelte Verneinung eine Bejahung.
In manchen Sprachen jedoch, etwa im Russischen, bleibt eine doppelte Verneinung eine Verneinung.
Aber es gibt keine einzige Sprache, nicht eine, in der eine doppelte Bejahung eine Verneinung ausdrücken kann.
Ja, ja.

notes: Both lines kept as written. The cop walks in on a nerdy young man in glasses at home; paren plays him as a programmer.
title: Explain Everything

lines.text: I'm arresting you for illegally downloading the entire Wikipedia!
Wait, I can explain everything!

notes: Translated line by line; 'я всё могу объяснить' keeps the double meaning. Cop walks in on a nerdy young man in glasses.
title: Всё объясню

lines.text: Вы арестованы за незаконное скачивание всей Википедии!
Подождите, я всё могу объяснить!

notes: Translated line by line; 'Ich kann alles erklären' keeps the double meaning. Cop walks in on a nerdy young man in glasses.
title: Alles erklären

lines.text: Ich verhafte Sie wegen illegalen Herunterladens der gesamten Wikipedia!
Moment, ich kann alles erklären!

notes: Breakfast in the kitchen, so no narrator; fixed the typo 'do I if won'. The husband hands over the money on the punchline.
title: Half the Winnings

lines.text: What would you do if I won the lottery?
I'd take half, and then leave you.
Great. I won twelve dollars yesterday.
Here's six dollars. Stay in touch.
